activities.activity: Review Pressure Structure Containment architecture allocation
activities.rationale: Confirm the module has a coherent purpose, submodule breakdown, interfaces and component allocation before any procurement work.
acceptanceCriteria: Every submodule has a stated purpose and at least one component candidate.
Interfaces named on the module are carried by the responsible submodule where the design depends on that interface.
No blocker or major architecture issue is attached to the module.

activities.activity: Verify Pressure Structure Containment requirement calculations
activities.rationale: Tie parsed brief requirements to explicit engineering calculations or sanity checks before accepting the design envelope.
acceptanceCriteria: Each linked requirement has a calculation, sanity check or clearly stated deferred validation path.
No linked sanity check is failing.
Warnings have named follow-up calculations or test evidence.

activities.activity: Collect source-backed evidence for Pressure Structure Containment critical components
activities.rationale: Critical component candidates may support architecture review, but BoM cost/manufacturer/MPN claims are blocked until source-backed evidence is admitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Supplier name, manufacturer or equivalent, MPN where applicable, unit cost and source URL/reference are present.
Evidence is explicitly retrieved and admissible under the sourcing admission protocol.
Claimed quantity and component identity match the architecture candidate line.

activities.moduleName: Subsea Energy Storage -> Subsea Power Distribution
activities.activity: Verify dc_power_bus interface contract
activities.rationale: Battery energy must enter protected DC distribution through an explicit bus.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Subsea Power Distribution -> Thruster Actuation Kinematics
activities.activity: Verify thruster_power_bus interface contract
activities.rationale: Thrusters must receive protected power separately from avionics and payload rails.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Autonomy Compute Communication -> Thruster Actuation Kinematics
activities.activity: Verify thrust_command_bus interface contract
activities.rationale: Mission control must command thruster drive states over a declared control interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Navigation And Payload Sensing -> Autonomy Compute Communication
activities.activity: Verify navigation_sensor_bus interface contract
activities.rationale: DVL, INS and depth data must feed navigation fusion before mission autonomy is credible.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Navigation And Payload Sensing -> Autonomy Compute Communication
activities.activity: Verify payload_data_bus interface contract
activities.rationale: Inspection payload data must be logged or acted on by the mission computer.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Pressure Thermal Buoyancy Interface -> Pressure Structure Containment
activities.activity: Verify pressure_boundary interface contract
activities.rationale: Hull, penetrators, thermal path and buoyancy hardware must share one depth-rated boundary model.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Leak Abort And Recovery Safety -> Autonomy Compute Communication
activities.activity: Verify alarm_bus interface contract
activities.rationale: Leak, over-depth and recovery alarms must drive fail-safe mission states.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Leak Abort And Recovery Safety -> Pressure Structure Containment
activities.activity: Verify pressure_boundary interface contract
activities.rationale: Leak and over-depth protection must reference the same pressure boundary as the hull design.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.activity: Plan evidence for PRESSURE-BOUNDARY-REVIEW
activities.rationale: Depth-rated pressure boundary review
acceptanceCriteria: Depth rating calculation, hull material allowables, endcap seal design and proof-pressure plan.
blockers: Compliance evidence not yet collected in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Plan evidence for SUBSEA-LEAK-ABORT-REVIEW
activities.rationale: Leak detection and abort-state review
acceptanceCriteria: Leak sensor placement, abort state machine, battery isolation and recovery procedure.
blockers: Compliance evidence not yet collected in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Plan evidence for EMC-MARINE-COMMS-REVIEW
activities.rationale: Marine communications and EMC review
acceptanceCriteria: Acoustic modem integration, antenna/transducer mounting, cable shielding and data-loss behaviour.
blockers: Compliance evidence not yet collected in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Pressure hull or seal failure at depth
activities.rationale: Provisional RPN 120; mitigation: Depth-rated pressure calculation, hydrostatic proof test, leak test and seal inspection workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.
Mitigation is accepted, corrected or converted into a design action.
Any residual high-risk item has an owner before publication.
blockers: Risk evidence not yet reviewed in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Loss of navigation or communications underwater
activities.rationale: Provisional RPN 160; mitigation: DVL/INS/depth fusion, acoustic link health monitoring and timed abort behaviour.
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.
Mitigation is accepted, corrected or converted into a design action.
Any residual high-risk item has an owner before publication.
blockers: Risk evidence not yet reviewed in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Unable to recover vehicle after abort
activities.rationale: Provisional RPN 96; mitigation: Recovery beacon, drop-weight/recovery procedure, deck handling points and mission reserve energy.
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.
Mitigation is accepted, corrected or converted into a design action.
Any residual high-risk item has an owner before publication.
blockers: Risk evidence not yet reviewed in scratch prototype.
